tournament.name: MTA S3 Championship Legacy Invitational - MTA Event

decks.notes: This control Lands deck focuses on utilizing cards like Urza's Saga, Life from the Loam, and Exploration to efficiently ramp up mana and control the board. By consistently hitting land drops and utilizing powerful lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage, the deck can quickly assemble powerful threats like a 20/20 Marit Lage token. Mox Diamond and Crop Rotation help accelerate the deck's game plan, while disruption cards like Wasteland and Boseiju, Who Endures help control the opponent's resources. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through powerful land interactions.

The deck relies on assembling the Doomsday combo as quickly as possible, using cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to generate mana efficiently. By casting Doomsday, the player can set up a specific pile of cards from their library, including Thassa's Oracle and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, to win the game on the spot. The deck also includes disruption like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo and control elements like Baleful Strix and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to help navigate through the game. The goal is to execute the combo and secure a victory before the opponent can disrupt it.

The deck focuses on utilizing its aggressive creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also generating card advantage and value through various synergies and interactions. The deck aims to establish early board presence and pressure while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Skyclave Apparition. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion rewards the player for playing a high number of cards in the deck, providing additional value and versatility. The deck excels at controlling the game and disrupting the opponent's plans while maintaining a strong board presence.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells, discard spells, and removal while also utilizing card draw and filtering effects to maintain card advantage. It includes a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Kolaghan's Command, along with powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. The deck also features cards like Cling to Dust and Baleful Strix for additional utility and card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and enable efficient casting of spells.

The main concept of this deck is to have a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing cards like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to put pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to control the board with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will while also dealing direct damage with Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The mana base is designed to support a quick and consistent mana curve, allowing the deck to maintain tempo and apply constant pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck focuses on being proactive and forcing the opponent to react to its threats.

This combo-reanimator deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then bringing them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck includes powerful disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces, while also utilizing Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for card advantage and control. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while disrupting their game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal while also maintaining tempo through efficient creatures and card draw. By utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Brazen Borrower, and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the game with cards like Force of Will and Daze. The mana base is designed to support a fast and consistent gameplay, allowing the player to quickly adapt to different situations and outmaneuver the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to apply pressure on the opponent quickly with low-cost aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm to filter through its library efficiently. In addition, the deck includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal with threats on the opposing side of the battlefield.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly assemble a board presence of artifact creatures and use mana acceleration to play powerful artifacts and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal, the deck aims to cast its spells ahead of schedule and overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats such as Glaring Fleshraker and Patchwork Automaton. With a mix of card advantage and disruption provided by cards like Thoughtcast and Force of Will, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in order to secure a victory.

Utilize a combination of spells and creatures to disrupt your opponent's game plan while continuously developing your own board presence and card advantage. Make use of counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect your threats and removal spells like Fatal Push and Murderous Cut to deal with your opponent's threats. Ramp up your mana with cards like Up the Beanstalk and use powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to close out the game. Control the game with disruptive spells and efficient threats to secure victory.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays by utilizing efficient creatures like Wight of the Reliquary and Scythecat Cub, supported by disruption from Thoughtseize and Endurance. The deck also has strong tutoring and ramp options with Green Sun's Zenith and Noble Hierarchs. The inclusion of cards like Crop Rotation and Gaea's Cradle allows for explosive plays, while the diverse land base with Wastelands and fetch lands provides flexibility and disruption. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents early and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of lands and disruptive spells. By using cards like Mox Diamond, Crop Rotation, and Life from the Loam, the deck aims to quickly assemble the Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage combo to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. Additionally, cards like Wasteland and Exploration help to disrupt opponent's mana base while Boseiju, Who Endures and Pithing Needle help to protect the combo and prevent key spells from being countered. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents by leveraging its land-based synergy.

The deck focuses on using Nadu, Winged Wisdom along with Nomads en-Kor and other supporting cards to create a powerful combo that can generate card advantage and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares for control and disruption, as well as Green Sun's Zenith for tutoring key creatures. The addition of cards like Brainstorm and Teferi, Time Raveler help with card selection and manipulation. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently while controlling the game and out-valuing the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between creatures like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Nomads en-Kor to generate explosive combos and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes utility creatures like Collector Ouphe and Sylvan Safekeeper to disrupt opponent strategies, as well as powerful finishers like Craterhoof Behemoth. The mana base is designed to support the deck's creature-heavy strategy, with cards like Gaea's Cradle and Green Sun's Zenith providing efficient mana ramp. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game before the opponent can react.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze, while also maintaining card advantage through Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The inclusion of Ninjas like Yuriko allows for additional utility and card draw, while cards like Fatal Push and Force of Will help control the board and protect key creatures.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Show and Tell and Omniscience to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul onto the battlefield for free. It includes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find the combo pieces, while also running plenty of disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. Thundertrap Trainer and Stock Up help to create additional value and card advantage, while Lórien Revealed can provide extra protection or disruption. The deck aims to combo off quickly and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful threats.
